A few quick next steps I proposed on the call:
- A technical alignment session where we bring Redwood infra + your engineering leads to go over environment, data flow, and integration points (60–75 minutes).
- Share a lightweight requirements doc and agenda ahead of the session.

I have two proposed windows (all PT):
- Wednesday, Apr 12 — 11:00–12:15 PT
- Thursday, Apr 13 — 09:00–10:15 PT

If either works, I can send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link (we can also provide Zoom if your security team prefers). I attached a short POC requirements draft — feel free to flag anything that looks off.

Suggested attendees from Redwood: me (Solutions), Marissa Cole (Engineering lead), Ben Carter (SRE). Please include any of your engineers who will own infra (CTO or SRE).

Thanks — Rafael
